craft_notes: Sthāyin: parokṣa-dīkṣā unit 25. Sanskrit-first kept. Rows: 13. Close: rest. Rejected: smoothing — killed: flagged. Read aloud: steady cadence.

lines: Having drawn the mind situated there — should do: that rite is said. Having risen from the mūlādhāra, the rod of the path of the vast spread endless nāḍī, having occupied by vigor, reached the nose-sky, throwing, desires to pervade up to the wheel of the path with a net of smoke-beautiful dense tips, covering — bringing the desired life — thus: the practice called the great net.
l4.sanskrit_cite: cittamākṛṣya tatrasthaṃ kuryāttadvidhirucyate mūlādhārādudetya prasṛtasuvitatānantanāḍyadhvadaṇḍaṃ vīryeṇākramya nāsāgaganaparigataṃ vikṣipan vyāptumīṣṭe yāvaddhūmābhirāmapracitataraśikhājālakenādhvacakraṃ saṃchādyābhīṣṭajīvānayanamiti mahājālanāmā prayogaḥ
